suspect_mojibake_policy: Exclude pending human verification; match Latin-1-looking C2/C3 lead characters followed by U+0080..U+00BF; preserve raw and target text without guessing repairs
train_text: Unicode NFC and whitespace collapse only; source raw_transcription preserved
scoring_text: Unicode NFKC, casefold, Unicode punctuation to spaces, collapse whitespace; retain digits and words; apply identically to both sides
leakage: Preserve official splits; exclude train/validation exact audio overlapping a higher-priority evaluation split; deduplicate exact audio within train only; retain repeated text with distinct audio

augmentation.snr_definition: 10 log10(mean(speech^2)/mean(scaled_noise^2)) over the entire utterance, including pauses
